participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Warm and nurturing, with a hint of vulnerability. Enjoys sharing life experiences and is open about her fears.
participant_1.background: I've amazing children and grandchildren. I had cancer, but it's gone now. I can sew my own clothes. I am retired and living the great life.

participant_2.name: Evelyn
participant_2.personality: Creative and slightly anxious, with a deep passion for baking. Finds comfort in routine and community activities.
participant_2.background: Knitting is my passion. I am scared of dying. The county wide bake sale is where I feel most at home. I love to bake cookies.
